title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4INMA - MaterialBatch
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/MaterialBatch . A uniform collection of tangible raw material relevant for the production process: either a set of objects with similar properties (e.g. a certain type of screw) or a stock of homogeneous material (e.g. oil, water). Unlike ItemBatch, individual pieces of material cannot be traced within a MaterialBatch (e.g. it is not possible to trace the individual screw used). Subclass of s4inma:Batch per the SAREF4INMA ontology; inherited properties (hasIdentifier, hasSize, needsEquipment, consistsOf) are documented on the Batch model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MaterialBatch'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

belongsToCategory.description: Relationship. The category of material this material batch belongs to. Target model: 'MaterialCategory'.

hasCertificate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4inma/hasCertificate'. A material quality certificate associated with this material batch, e.g. a BS EN 10204:2004 clause 3.1 steel certificate.
